posts.trend: Delhi Metro new timings for Sunday: DMRC announces trains from 3:30 am for Delhi Half Marathon
posts.context: The gap between workplace energy levels and voluntary weekend suffering.
posts.angle: You cannot wake up at 7 AM for a call, but you will stand in dark fog at 4 AM for a metal medal.
slides: Your manager cannot get you on a call before 10 AM.

Yet here you are.
Standing on a platform.
At 3:30 AM in shorts.
Checking your pulse rate on a ₹30,000 watch.

The race hasn't even started.

Your lower back has already submitted its resignation.
posts.caption: Whose husband is currently stretching his hamstring against a metro pillar at 3:45 AM?
posts.rank_verdict: The lower-back joke is predictable and lazy, failing to deliver a true turn.
